text:
```yaml
name: Deploy OfficeIMO Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    env:
      PSWRITEOFFICE_ROOT: ${{ secrets.PSWRITEOFFICE_ROOT }}
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build website
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot $env:PSWRITEOFFICE_ROOT

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./Website/_site
          publish_branch: gh-pages
          user_name: github-actions[bot]
          user_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          commit_message: 'Deploy website from ${{ github.sha }}'

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (optional)
        if: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN != '' }}
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages publish ./Website/_site --project-name officeimo
          workingDirectory: .
```
